scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:tunnel: ROOST_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${TUNNEL_ORIGIN:?设置为你的隧道入口，例如 http://example:15173} ROOST_AUTH_INSECURE_HTTP=1 VITE_HMR_CLIENT_PORT=${TUNNEL_PORT:-15173} npm start
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm test --workspaces --if-present && npm run build --workspace frontend && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
